# PINTAR 4.0 — User-facing terminology inventory

**Status: evidence only.** No application code, wording or terminology was changed, and nothing here recommends or decides wording. Where two terms look alike, this document flags them for review. It does not say whether they mean the same thing, except where a canonical decision says so explicitly.

- **Prepared by:** Daisy (UX-1 lane), 28 Sep 2026, for the language-system review before the PINTAR 4.0 UI/UX redesign.
- **Code inventoried:** `ux-1/daisy-experience` at `15bfc99`: main `141362e` (Integration 12) plus BOB-10 Q2, BOB-17 and DAISY-16. This is the head handed off for Integration 13.
  - Compared with main, the new wording is DAISY-16's blocker lines (`studio.hambatan.*`) and the role list on the mapping screen.
- **Not included:** DAISY-13 (the class-card result screen), which is held off the lane until BOB-12; BOB-20 (a school admin sees their own staff), which is on Bob's lane for Integration 14.

## How this was gathered

Read from the code only. No page was judged by eye, and no wording was inferred.

1. **The copy table.** Every row of `src/lib/hle.ts` was read through its own exports (`allKeys`, `telling`). That gives the exact Bahasa Indonesia (`default`) and English (`en`), every persona override, and the learner stage variants (`stageTable`). D-014 puts all user-visible words there, and the key names are the contract.
2. **Where each string is used.** Every `.ts`/`.tsx` file under `src/` was swept for:
   - keys written literally;
   - keys built at run time from a template (e.g. `` `mengajar.instrumen.${mode}` ``, `` `studio.langkah.${k}.${bagian}` ``);
   - keys built by `enumLabel(kind, value)`;
   - keys the **database** stores and a generic renderer draws (`label_key`, `meaning_key`, `statement_key`: metric names, readiness tiers, feedback questions and options).
3. **Screen / route.** Each page's import closure plus its layouts, loading and error files. A string reached through a shared shell is listed with every route that shell serves, as "N routes: …".
4. **Roles.** Taken from each route's gate (§3.2). For a string inside a shared shell, the route's role set is an upper bound, because the shell may show the string only to some roles (a Studio tab, for example).
5. **Type.** Read from the markup around the call: `h1`, `h2`, `button`, submit button, navigation link, form label, `placeholder=`, `aria-label=`, list item and so on. Where the call sits inside a helper or a lookup table, the type is read from the key's name instead, and marked `*`.
6. **English actually shown?** Each call was checked for whether it passes the reader's language. Where every call passes none, the English cell exists but is never displayed; these rows are marked **⚑ never shown**.
7. **Concept / action.** The key (the contract name) and the note written beside the row in `hle.ts`, when there is one. Nothing else.
8. **Other wording.** For each concept family a string belongs to (Table 2), the column shows two things: the term(s) the string itself uses, and the other terms of that family used most often elsewhere in PINTAR (up to four in Indonesian and three in English). A shared family is evidence to review, not a claim that two strings mean the same thing.
9. **Outside the copy table (§1.2).** An AST sweep of JSX text, literal attributes, metadata, dialogs, generated files (the lesson workbook template), certificates, e-mail and auth templates, route-handler output, identifiers printed on screen, seed data and `public/`.
10. **Navigation (Table 3).** Shells, tabs, doors, sub-navigation, headings and main actions, each resolved through `t()` with the persona the call site passes, with `file:line`.

Two parts of steps 9 and 10 were gathered by helper agents and spot-checked against the source before inclusion: hard-coded words on /konfigurasi and /studio/definisi, the metadata description, the pre-filled report title, the fixed `PENGUASAAN` mode on quick assessments, the refusal wording, and the helpers that pass no language.

## Legend

- **«…»** quotes exact text. Line breaks are shown as spaces; a `|` inside text is escaped.
- **Roles** use the database role codes, so this document chooses no display name for them:

| Code | Database role / audience |
|---|---|
| PUB | signed-out visitor, or anyone holding a certificate link |
| STU | `STUDENT` (a learner) |
| EDU | `EDUCATOR` |
| HOD | `HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT` |
| DEAN | `DEAN` |
| IA | `INSTITUTION_ADMIN` |
| SA | `SYSTEM_ADMIN` |
| EVAL | a registered evaluator on `/evaluasi` |
| ALL | error and not-found pages |

- **Type**: a type ending in `*` comes from the key's name, not the markup.
- **Source**:
  - "(built)" means the key is assembled at run time.
  - "(data)" means the database supplies the key.
  - `hle.ts:N` is the row in the copy table.
- **⚑ never shown**: every call that renders this string passes no language, so the Indonesian shows in English mode too.
- **⚑ shown on some screens only**: call sites differ; some pass the language and some do not.
- **Families**: F01–F33 are defined in §2.1.

## What the evidence shows (observations, not recommendations)

Counts are of distinct copy-table strings unless stated otherwise.

**Size**
- The copy table holds 1,433 rows.
  - 1,385 are rendered.
  - 48 have no usage site, and 3 more are used only by a component that no page imports (§1.3).
- Only one row varies by persona: `tolak.arti` has a staff telling.
- Five learner rows have school-stage variants: `cycle.title`, `cycle.none`, `pretest.intro`, `posttest.intro` and `sertifikat.sedang_disiapkan`.

**English that exists but is never displayed**
- 199 rendered strings have an English telling that no screen displays, because every call passes no language. 18 more are shown in English on some screens only.
- The surfaces concerned:
  - Studio's shared helper (`src/app/studio/_lib.ts:15`);
  - most of `/konfigurasi` (`src/app/konfigurasi/page.tsx:40`);
  - the assessment and lesson players;
  - `/evaluasi` and its banner;
  - the two summary pages.
- On those surfaces, locale-aware tabs sit beside Indonesian-only headings (§3.5 F).
- No language switch is mounted on `/`, `/konfigurasi`, `/studio/**`, the summary pages, `/evaluasi`, the refusal page, not-found or error.

**School / institution (F01)**
- "sekolah" appears in 101 strings and "institusi" in 6; English has "school" in 109 and "institution" in 7.
- One outcome reads «Diteruskan ke pihak sekolah» in both places it appears. Its English is «Passed to the school» in one and «Escalated to the institution» in the other (§2.3).

**Learner and teacher (F03, F04)**
- Learner: "murid" 57, "siswa" 9, "peserta didik" 4, "peserta" 2.
  - English splits between "student(s)" (43) and "learner(s)" (30), sometimes for the same Indonesian word: «murid» is rendered «students», «Student» and «Learners» (§2.3).
- Teacher: "guru" 18, "pengajar" 7, "pendidik" 1; English "teacher(s)" 17, "educator(s)" 10.

**Content container (F08, F09)**
- "materi" 36, "kursus" 33, "isi" 30, "paket" 24; English "material" 29, "course" 29, "content" 22, "package(s)" 24.
- Studio's home heading is «Paket Pembelajaran». Its tab is «Buat Paket» and the page it opens is headed «Buat Paket Pembelajaran». The workbook's first sheet is «Kursus» (D-007), and the button after an upload reads «Buka kursus».

**Assessments (F18, F19)** — the same stored values carry different names (§2.2):

| Stored value | Label on the Studio definitions page (`jenis.mode.*`) | Label on the teacher and learner screens |
|---|---|---|
| `PRE_TEST` | «Penilaian awal» | «Pemetaan Awal» |
| `POST_TEST` | «Penilaian akhir» | «Uji Penguasaan» |
| `QUICK` | «Penilaian cepat» | «Uji Cepat» (D-015 says "Uji Cepat" everywhere) |
| `STANDALONE` | «Penilaian mandiri» | «Asesmen mandiri» |

- The workbook marks post-test questions «Cek penguasaan» (D-008). The learner meets «Uji Penguasaan», and both are «Mastery Check» in English.
- A teacher's Uji Cepat opens for the learner under the heading «Uji Penguasaan» / «Mastery Check», because the page fixes the mode (§3.5 A25).

**School structure (F02)**
- The English interface keeps «Bagian», «Tingkat» and «Kelas» untranslated in 22 strings (§2.4).
- "bagian" is also used in its everyday sense "part": «bagian isi», and «Bagian sekolah» rendered «Part of the school» (§2.7).
- «Kelas» is both a structure unit (D-006) and the teacher's navigation label (en «Classes»).

**Role names in refusals (§3.5 G)**
- Refusal pages name roles in words used nowhere else: «kepala program», «pengelola sistem», «administrator sekolah», «pengelola data sekolah», «staf pengelola isi».
- The role labels themselves are «Kepala departemen» and «Admin sekolah», and `/konfigurasi` admits both IA and SA.

**Navigation (§3.5)**
- 26 labels differ from the heading of the page they open.
- 28 routes are compared with their visible labels; in 26 the Indonesian label differs from the route segment (e.g. `/mengajar` is labelled «Kelas»; `/studio/kuis` is labelled «Uji Cepat»).
- 20 destinations carry different labels in different places. `/belajar` alone is «Belajar», «Pembelajaran Saya», «Saya mau belajar», «Beranda» and «Kembali ke Belajar».
- 8 labels lead to different destinations («Uji Cepat», «Sertifikat», «Beranda», «Keluar»).

**Words outside the copy table (§1.2)**
- Indonesian-only placeholders on Studio pages.
- An Indonesian-only site description.
- Hard-coded «aktif» / «nonaktif» / «sintetis» on `/konfigurasi`.
- Database-written question-quality findings, one of them English only.
- Certificate grade words («Sangat Baik» … «Perlu Pendampingan») under the English label «Grade».
- A workbook guidance line that cites the decision number «D-008».
- Identifiers on screen: learning-objective codes, UUID prefixes, enum values such as `PRACTICE` / `ITEMS_AND_OPTIONS`, metric ids, audit action codes and the environment name.
- On the teacher's evidence page, topic names are passed to the copy table as keys, so every topic row reads «—» (`src/app/mengajar/[kelas]/bukti/page.tsx:183`).

### 1.2 User-visible text that does not come from the copy table

Scope: text a PINTAR user can see that is **not** returned by `t()` from `src/lib/hle.ts`. Copy-table keys are cited only where a category requires them (confirmation dialogs, template guidance, certificate).

**How it was searched**
- A TypeScript-AST pass over every `src/**/*.tsx`: JSX text nodes containing letters; string or template literals that reach a rendered JSX child through only `?:`, `&&`, `||`, `??`, `+` or template spans; and every JSX attribute with a literal value.
- An AST pass over every `src/**/*.ts(x)` for string literals that contain whitespace, plus a regex pass for capitalised one-word literals.
- Every JSX child expression that prints a bare identifier or field (279 sites), each reviewed by hand.
- `grep` for `window.confirm|alert|prompt`, `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `metadata`, `generateMetadata`, `<title`, manifest, robots and sitemap files.
- A manual read of every page and component that renders data.
- The seeds under `supabase/seed/`, the migrations that write rendered text, `supabase/config.toml` and `public/`.
- The xlsx template was produced by running its own builder `lembarTemplat()` under `tsx` from the scratchpad, and its cells were dumped. Nothing was written into the repo.

**Roles** in the tables below are as the agent read each gate. The authoritative route → roles table, with gate evidence, is §3.2. Where the two differ, §3.2 holds; for example `/mengajar/**` admits any role whose grant scope contains the class, not only EDUCATOR.

---

##### 1.2.4b JSON package example
- **None under `public/` or `src/`.** `selftest/fixtures/bob02/contoh-pelajaran.paket.json` (with `contoh-pelajaran.xlsx`, `contoh-pelajaran-v1.xlsx`, `contoh-excel.xlsx`, `contoh-gsheets.xlsx`) is a test fixture read only by `selftest/unggah.test.ts`. No route or page serves it.
- For reference, its visible-type strings include: course `Pecahan untuk Kelas 4` (Matematika, SD, Kelas 4, Akademik); chapters `Mengenal pecahan`, `Pecahan senilai`; lessons `Apa itu pecahan?`, `Pecahan yang senilai`; media file names `Kue Empat Potong.png`, `penjelasan-senilai.mp3`; enum values in the JSON: `UNDERSTAND`, `APPLY`, `MCQ_SINGLE`, `MCQ_MULTI`, `PRE_TEST`, `POST_TEST`.
- On /studio/unggah the two JSON textareas start as `{}` (see §1.2.2).

#### 1.2.10 Notes that bear on the inventory (copy-table text, listed as facts only)

- **Copy-table text rendered without the reader's locale** (always Indonesian, although an English variant exists):
  - `src/app/belajar/_components/ItemPlayer.tsx` (16 calls) and `LessonPlayer.tsx` (8 calls) call `t(k, "learner")` with no locale.
  - Studio `s()` (`src/app/studio/_lib.ts:15`) and `/konfigurasi` `s()` (`konfigurasi/page.tsx:40`) omit it. Only some sections use `sl()` or `locale`.
  - `/evaluasi` and the evaluation banner (`e = t(k,"staff")`).
  - `/dekan/ringkasan` and `/edukator/ringkasan`: the `_intel.ts:26` `s()` defaults `locale` to `"id"`, and the pages never pass it.
  - Root metadata title (`layout.tsx:8`).
  - The xlsx template is Indonesian by design (`templat.ts:229`).
- **Copy keys reused in an unrelated position:**
  - `config.section.roles` (`Peran & akses` / `Roles & access`) labels the *school* picker on /studio/definisi:59 and /studio/sertifikat:39.
  - `studio.definisi.simpan` labels the distribution-grant button on /studio/kanonik:97.
  - `studio.paket.terbitkan` labels the release pickers on /studio/kanonik:87 and /studio/paket:220.
- **Copy-table English variants identical to the Indonesian:** `config.struktur.jenis.BAGIAN|TINGKAT|KELAS` = `Bagian`/`Tingkat`/`Kelas` in `en` too (hle.ts:2007-2009). The English template-guidance keys also name the Indonesian sheet names.

## TABLE 2 — POTENTIAL TERMINOLOGY COLLISIONS

Terms are grouped when they **appear** to describe the same or a closely related concept. The grouping is lexical: a family collects the words, and every inflection found, that name one idea in either language. Nothing here asserts that two terms mean the same thing.

The **"Same concept?"** column reads **UNDETERMINED — requires review** everywhere except where a canonical decision rules explicitly. Only one such ruling exists: D-015 says the quick quiz is "Uji Cepat" everywhere, not "Kuis Cepat". Other decisions that name a term, without ruling that two terms are one concept, are cited in the last column so the review can weigh them.

Counts are distinct copy-table strings that contain the term. "Locations" names the surfaces (the Table 1 groups) and the top-level routes where those strings render. §2.8 lists every term with three exact examples each.

### 2.7 Indonesian and English name different concept families

270 strings in which a family term appears in one language and no term of the same family appears in the other. Families F16 and F29–F33 (checks, outcomes, waiting, reference codes, readiness) are left out as too generic. The match is lexical: it includes words used in another sense (for example "bagian" as "part", "orang" as "someone"), and those ambiguities are themselves part of the evidence.

### 3.1 Mechanics that decide who is offered what

#### 3.1.1 Landing after sign-in
- The magic link and the classroom card both redirect to `tujuanMasuk(raw)` (`app/masuk/actions.ts:146-150`; `app/auth/callback/actions.ts:28`; `lanjutkanSesi` :175-177; card :128).
  - A valid internal `lanjut` wins.
  - `"/"` counts as "no destination" (:148).
  - Otherwise the fallback is `berandaPeran(viewer.displayRole)`.
- `berandaPeran` (`lib/beranda.ts:42-58`):

| Display role | Landing |
|---|---|
| STUDENT | `/belajar` (:44-45) |
| EDUCATOR | `/mengajar` (:46-47) |
| HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT, DEAN | `/pimpinan` (:48-50) |
| INSTITUTION_ADMIN, SYSTEM_ADMIN | `/konfigurasi` (:51-53) |
| null / unknown | `/` (:55-56) |

- `displayRole` is the highest active role by `role_rank` (`supabase/migrations/20260912004431_authorization.sql:238-245`).
  - Rank order: STUDENT 1 &lt; EDUCATOR 2 &lt; HOD 3 &lt; DEAN 4 &lt; INSTITUTION_ADMIN 5 &lt; SYSTEM_ADMIN 6 (`20260912004158_foundation_base.sql:42-47`).
  - With no role, it is STUDENT if the person has an ACTIVE enrolment, otherwise null.
  - **So a person holding several roles lands on the home of the most senior one.**
- Signing out from the session strip POSTs to `/keluar`, which redirects to `/` (`app/keluar/route.ts:23`). Signing out on `/masuk` redirects to `/masuk` (`app/masuk/actions.ts:162-168`).
- An anonymous visitor on any non-public path is redirected to `/masuk?lanjut=<path>` (`proxy.ts:87-95`).
  - Public paths are `/`, `/masuk`, `/masuk/kartu`, `/auth/callback` and `/keluar` (`proxy.ts:16`), plus the prefixes `/verifikasi/` and `/api/verifikasi/` (:41).
  - `/masuk/kartu` is listed as public but has no page file under `src/app/masuk/`.

#### 3.1.2 Places offered by role (`components/tempat.ts`)
- `URUTAN` (display order) = `/mengajar`, `/pimpinan`, `/konfigurasi` (:32).
- Labels (:34-38):
  - `/mengajar` → `nav.kelas`
  - `/pimpinan` → `nav.pimpinan`
  - `/konfigurasi` → `nav.konfigurasi`
- `tempatDariPeran(peran)` = the set of `berandaPeran` values of the reader's **active role assignments**, in URUTAN order (:41-45). A STUDENT holds no role assignment, so they get `[]`.
- `daftarTempat` draws those places minus the ones the calling shell already draws (:48-57).
- The Studio tab is drawn when `tawarkanStudio(peran)` is true, i.e. any of `PERAN_STUDIO` = EDUCATOR, HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT, INSTITUTION_ADMIN, SYSTEM_ADMIN (:72-77). DEAN is not offered Studio. Where the Studio tab is drawn: `components/TabTempat.tsx:39-44`.
- Home doors `pintuMasuk(displayRole, peran)` (:97-100):
  - `/belajar` only when displayRole === "STUDENT".
  - Then `tempatDariPeran`.
  - An educator who is also enrolled has displayRole EDUCATOR, so they get **no** Belajar door.
- The capability map by role (`supabase/migrations/20260926100000_a_school_gives_a_person_a_number.sql:137-164`):

| Role | Capabilities |
|---|---|
| SYSTEM_ADMIN | all Studio capabilities + CAN_PROVISION_PEOPLE + roster/result |
| INSTITUTION_ADMIN | all Studio capabilities + CAN_PROVISION_PEOPLE + CAN_VIEW_LEARNER_ROSTER (no CAN_VIEW_LEARNER_RESULT) |
| HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT | CAN_DRAFT, CAN_REVIEW, CAN_FREEZE_RELEASE, CAN_ASSIGN_LEARNING, CAN_QUICK_ASSESSMENT, CAN_REVIEW_QUESTION_HEALTH, CAN_REVIEW_INTEGRITY, roster, result |
| EDUCATOR | CAN_DRAFT, CAN_ASSIGN_LEARNING, CAN_QUICK_ASSESSMENT, roster, result |
| DEAN | CAN_VIEW_LEARNER_ROSTER only |
| STUDENT | none |

- Management authority: `management_scope_over_node` = an active HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT or DEAN grant whose scope contains the node.
  - Definition: `20260924110000_pintar_proposes_a_human_decides.sql:128-146`.
  - Role list: `20260923130000_management_may_open_a_learner_on_purpose.sql:228-236`.
  - INSTITUTION_ADMIN and SYSTEM_ADMIN are excluded.
- Whether `/belajar` gets the "educator-learning" shell: `konteksPembelajaran` → `turPengajarBerlaku` = the person holds EDUCATOR **and** none of HOD, DEAN, INSTITUTION_ADMIN, SYSTEM_ADMIN (`lib/pembelajaran.ts:79-82`; `lib/tur.ts:179`, `:215-218`).

- every CangkangPengalaman shell except public;

- `/konfigurasi` (:225);
- `/dekan/ringkasan` (:55) and `/edukator/ringkasan` (:72);
- the refusal page (`HalamanPenolakan.tsx:47`).

Other sign-out-like controls:
- `/masuk` when already signed in: `auth.in_out` "Keluar dari sesi ini" / "Sign out of this session" (`app/masuk/page.tsx:83`).
- The evaluation banner on every page during an evaluation session: `evaluasi.keluar` "Keluar dari peragaan" / "Leave the demonstration" [id-only] and link `evaluasi.ganti` "Ganti sudut pandang" / "Change the point of view" [id-only] → `/evaluasi` (`app/_evaluation-banner.tsx:21-30`).

### 3.3 Subtrees: every place, its pages, headings and actions

Each place's subtree is written once (§3.3.1–2.9). The per-role sections (§3.4) state which shell, tabs and subtrees the role actually gets.

#### 3.3.1 BELAJAR subtree (learner persona unless noted)

**`/belajar`** — `app/belajar/page.tsx`
- Shell: learner shell, or the educator-learning shell for a pure educator (:185; §3.1.3).
- Eyebrow (:188-190):
  - learner: `siklus.beranda` "Beranda" / "Home"
  - pure educator: `pembelajaran.eyebrow` "Pembelajaran Saya" / "My Learning"
- h1 (:191-193): `siklus.halo` "Halo" / "Hello" + ", " + (data: first name, or full name for staff).
- Intro (:199-203):
  - pure educator: `pembelajaran.milik` "Ini pembelajaran Anda sendiri, terpisah dari kelas yang Anda ajar." / "This is your own learning, separate from the classes you teach."
  - learner with tasks: `siklus.hari_ini` "Ini yang sedang berjalan hari ini." / "Here is what is under way for you today."
- Main panel (eyebrow `siklus.lanjutkan` "Lanjutkan" / "Continue", :210):
  - Primary button (:225-227). Its label depends on the step (`aksi()`, :165-174):
    - PEMETAAN → `siklus.mulai` "Mulai" / "Start" → `/belajar/[id]/pemetaan`
    - PETA → `siklus.lihat_peta` "Lihat peta bacaan" / "See the reading map" → `/belajar/[id]/peta`

### 3.4 Per role

#### 3.4.1 Signed-out visitor (public)
- Landing: `/` (signed-out variant, §3.3.7).
- Primary navigation: the three doors on `/`:
  - "Saya mau belajar" / "I want to learn" → `/belajar` → `/masuk?lanjut=/belajar`
  - "Saya mengajar" / "I teach" → `/masuk?peran=guru`
  - "Saya mengelola sekolah" / "I run the school" → `/masuk?peran=staf`
- There is no shell, no language switch on `/`, and no sign-out.
- Secondary:
  - `/masuk` screens: email ↔ card, sent.
  - `/auth/callback`: expired → "Minta tautan baru".
  - `/verifikasi/[token]`: public shell, no links (`components/MerekPintar.tsx` is not a link).
- Any protected URL → `/masuk?lanjut=…` (`proxy.ts:87-95`).
- Page titles and actions: §3.2 and §3.3.7.

#### 3.4.2 STUDENT (Murid; persona learner)
- Landing: `/belajar` (`beranda.ts:44-45`). Requires display role STUDENT, i.e. an active enrolment and no role assignment.
- Home doors on `/`: [`entry.learner` "Saya mau belajar" / "I want to learn" → `/belajar`] (`tempat.ts:98`).
- Primary nav (learner shell, `CangkangPengalaman.tsx:240-265`):
  1. `nav.belajar` "Belajar" / "Learning" → `/belajar`
  2. `nav.sertifikat` "Sertifikat" / "Certificates" → `/belajar/sertifikat`
  3. then Help `nav.bantuan` "Bantuan" / "Help", language ID/EN, and the session strip "Bukan akun Anda?" / "Not your account?" + "Keluar" / "Sign out"
- During an assessment: focus shell (no tabs; language + session strip).
- `tempatDariPeran([])` = [], so there are no staff tabs and no Studio.
- Secondary: the whole §3.3.1 BELAJAR subtree (home panel, `/belajar/[tugas]` trail and pages, certificates, feedback sheet, quick assessments).
- Tour: learner tour (§3.3.10).
- Pages a student can open by typing, not offered:
  - `/mengajar` renders with the pengajar shell and an empty class list (no page gate; `lib/pengajar.ts:93-102`). Tabs "Kelas", "Pembelajaran Saya" and the Help button (educator) are drawn.
  - `/dekan/ringkasan` and `/edukator/ringkasan` render (no page gate).
  - `/pimpinan`, `/konfigurasi`, `/studio`, `/pendataan` and `/aktivasi` render refusals.

#### 3.4.3 EDUCATOR (Guru; persona educator)
- Landing: `/mengajar` (`beranda.ts:46-47`).
- Home doors: [`entry.educator` "Saya mengajar" / "I teach" → `/mengajar`]. No Belajar door, even if the person is enrolled (`tempat.ts:98`).
- Primary nav on `/mengajar/**` (pengajar shell, `CangkangPengalaman.tsx:129-155`):
  1. `nav.kelas` "Kelas" / "Classes" → `/mengajar` (current)
  2. `nav.pembelajaran` "Pembelajaran Saya" / "My Learning" → `/belajar`
  3. `nav.studio` "Studio" / "Studio" → `/studio`
  4. Help "Bantuan" / "Help" → `/mengajar?bantuan=1`
  5. ID/EN
  6. "Masuk sebagai &lt;name>" / "Signed in as &lt;name>" + "Keluar" / "Sign out"
- Primary nav on `/belajar/**` (educator-learning shell, `:213-238`):
  1. "Kelas" / "Classes" → `/mengajar`
  2. "Pembelajaran Saya" / "My Learning" (current) → `/belajar`
  3. "Studio" → `/studio`
  4. ID/EN, session strip. **No Help button.**
  - The `/belajar` eyebrow is "Pembelajaran Saya" / "My Learning", and there is an extra Sertifikat section (§3.3.1).
- On `/studio/**`: Studio layout header. Places nav "Tempat kerja Anda" / "Your places": "Kelas" / "Classes" → `/mengajar`. Studio sub-nav: all 9 items [id-only] (§3.3.6).
  - Pages filtered by capability. EDUCATOR holds CAN_DRAFT, CAN_ASSIGN_LEARNING, CAN_QUICK_ASSESSMENT: unggah, kuis and definisi are usable. Tinjau, bank, integritas and sertifikat show empty or non-actionable states (`tinjau/page.tsx:25-26`; `bank/page.tsx:24`; `integritas/page.tsx:22-23`; `studio/sertifikat/page.tsx:21`).
- Secondary: the §3.3.2 MENGAJAR subtree:
  - class list → class page → action row ("Siapkan materi", "Uji Cepat", "Lihat bukti", "Langkah berikutnya", "Umpan balik kelas")
  - class switcher "Pindah kelas"
  - sub-pages siapkan, uji-cepat, bukti, langkah, siapa, umpan-balik
  - Langkah card f6 "Susun materi sendiri" → `/studio/unggah`
- Own learning: the §3.3.1 subtree under the educator-learning shell.
- Tour: educator tour (§3.3.10). The learner tour is never mounted for a pure educator (`belajar/page.tsx:362`).

#### 3.4.4 HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT (Kepala departemen; persona staff on Pimpinan)
- Landing: `/pimpinan` (`beranda.ts:48-50`).
- Home doors: [`entry.pimpinan` "Saya memimpin bagian sekolah" / "I lead part of the school" → `/pimpinan`].
- Primary nav on `/pimpinan/**` (pimpinan shell, `:157-173`):
  1. `nav.pimpinan` "Pimpinan" / "Management" (current) → `/pimpinan`
  2. `nav.studio` "Studio" → `/studio`
  3. ID/EN, session strip. **No Help.**
- On `/studio/**`: places "Pimpinan" / "Management" → `/pimpinan`. Sub-nav: all 9 items.
  - HOD has no CAN_PUBLISH: kanonik publish and sertifikat are not actionable.
  - Tinjau, bank and integritas are actionable (CAN_REVIEW, CAN_REVIEW_QUESTION_HEALTH, CAN_REVIEW_INTEGRITY).
- Secondary: the §3.3.3 PIMPINAN subtree:
  - scope picker "Bagian sekolah"; decisions; per-class "Buka ringkasan kelas ini" → `/edukator/ringkasan`
  - "Lihat lebih rinci" → `/pimpinan/[simpul]`, then "Buka umpan balik kelas", "Murid pada bagian ini", child scopes
  - "Buka ringkasan sekolah" → `/dekan/ringkasan` (when a school figure is readable)
  - The report pages have no shell or back link.
- `/belajar` for an HOD: learner shell ("Belajar", "Sertifikat", Help), and the learner tour is mounted (`pembelajaran.ts:79-82`). No tab leads back to Pimpinan.
- `/mengajar` (typed, or via a tab when HOD+EDUCATOR): pengajar shell "Kelas", "Pembelajaran Saya", "Pimpinan", "Studio", Help. The educator tour is not offered (`mengajar/page.tsx:79`, `:213`).

#### 3.4.5 DEAN (Dekan; persona staff)
- Landing: `/pimpinan`. Home door "Saya memimpin bagian sekolah" / "I lead part of the school".
- Primary nav (pimpinan shell): 1. "Pimpinan" / "Management". That is the only tab: `tawarkanStudio` is false for DEAN (`tempat.ts:72-77`). Then ID/EN and the session strip.
- Secondary: the same §3.3.3 subtree. School and class summaries are shown only when a figure is readable (`pimpinan/page.tsx:97-98`).
- `/studio` is refused with `studio.refused` (DEAN holds none of `STUDIO_CAPABILITIES`; `studio/_lib.ts:24-32`).
- `/belajar`: learner shell as for HOD.

#### 3.4.6 INSTITUTION_ADMIN (Admin sekolah; persona staff)
- Landing: `/konfigurasi` (`beranda.ts:51-53`). Home door `entry.staff` "Saya mengelola sekolah" / "I run the school".
- Primary nav on `/konfigurasi` (own header, §3.3.4), place links in order:
  1. "Menambahkan orang" [id-only] → `/pendataan` (when CAN_PROVISION_PEOPLE)
  2. "Aktivasi akun" [id-only] → `/aktivasi`
  3. "Studio" [id-only] → `/studio`
  4. then the TabTempat of any other roles
  - No language switch and no Help. Session strip present.
- Primary nav on `/pendataan/**` and `/aktivasi` (pendataan shell):
  1. "Pendataan" / "Intake"
  2. "Aktivasi akun" / "Account activation"
  3. "Konfigurasi" / "Configuration"
  4. "Studio"
  5. ID/EN, session strip
- On `/studio/**`: places "Konfigurasi" / "Configuration" → `/konfigurasi`. Sub-nav: all 9 items; publish, sertifikat, tinjau, bank and integritas are all actionable.
- Secondary:
  - `/konfigurasi` section menu (12 anchors, §3.3.4); Struktur school picker; Laporan links → `/dekan/ringkasan`, `/edukator/ringkasan`
  - `/pendataan` school picker → jobs → `/pendataan/[pekerjaan]`
  - `/aktivasi` per-person activation buttons
- `/pimpinan` is refused (`pimpinan.ditolak`). IA is excluded by `management_scope_over_node`.

#### 3.4.7 SYSTEM_ADMIN (Admin platform; persona staff)
- Landing: `/konfigurasi`. Home door "Saya mengelola sekolah" / "I run the school".
- Primary nav on `/konfigurasi`:
  - "Aktivasi akun" and "Studio" (+ other roles' places).
  - "Menambahkan orang" is normally **absent**: `bolehPendataan` asks the same CAN_PROVISION_PEOPLE-per-institution predicate as `/pendataan` (`konfigurasi/page.tsx:197-202`; `lib/pendataan.ts:60-80`).
  - SA-only content: "Kesehatan sistem" check link; Roles section lists persons awaiting a first role (read at :119, listed at :500-502).
- `/aktivasi` admits SA (`aktivasi/page.tsx:36-41`) and shows the pendataan shell: "Pendataan" / "Intake", "Aktivasi akun", "Konfigurasi", "Studio". The "Pendataan" tab leads to `/pendataan`, which refuses SA (`pendataan.ditolak`).
  - Extra SA section: "Orang baru di luar pendataan" / "Buat dan aktifkan".
- `/studio`: as IA. `/pimpinan`: refused.

#### 3.4.8 People holding several roles (from the same code)
- Tabs are the union of `tempatDariPeran` over all active roles, in the order Kelas → Pimpinan → Konfigurasi, then Studio. Each shell drops its own place (§3.1.2).
- The landing is the most senior role's home (§3.1.1).
- Home doors: one per place, in URUTAN order, plus Belajar only when displayRole = STUDENT.

| Role set | Landing | Shell where it applies | Tabs in order |
|---|---|---|---|
| EDUCATOR + HOD | `/pimpinan` | pimpinan shell | Pimpinan · Kelas · Studio |
| | | pengajar shell | Kelas · Pembelajaran Saya · Pimpinan · Studio |
| | | `/belajar` | **learner** shell (not educator-learning): Belajar · Sertifikat · Help |
| EDUCATOR + INSTITUTION_ADMIN | `/konfigurasi` | konfigurasi places | [Menambahkan orang] · Aktivasi akun · Studio · Kelas |
| | | pengajar shell | Kelas · Pembelajaran Saya · Konfigurasi · Studio |
| DEAN + INSTITUTION_ADMIN | `/konfigurasi` | pimpinan shell | Pimpinan · Konfigurasi · Studio (Studio via IA) |
| HOD + DEAN | `/pimpinan` | pimpinan shell | Pimpinan · Studio |
| enrolled EDUCATOR | `/mengajar` (display EDUCATOR) | pengajar shell | "Pembelajaran Saya" is the way to `/belajar`; there is no home door for it |

#### F. Language rendering gaps on navigation surfaces
- These are [id-only]: the en cell exists but the Indonesian text shows in both languages.
  - The Studio sub-nav, the Studio h1 and eyebrow, and every Studio page heading and most Studio buttons (`studio/_lib.ts:15`).
  - The Konfigurasi h1, eyebrow, section menu, most section headings and buttons, and the place links "Menambahkan orang", "Aktivasi akun" and "Studio" (`konfigurasi/page.tsx:40`, `:239-241`).
  - `/evaluasi` and the evaluation banner.
  - The h1 on `/dekan/ringkasan` and `/edukator/ringkasan` (`_intel.ts:26-27`).
  - All assessment-player controls (ItemPlayer).
- The TabTempat links on the same surfaces are locale-aware. In English, the Konfigurasi place row therefore reads "Menambahkan orang · Aktivasi akun · Studio · Classes/Management" (`konfigurasi/page.tsx:239-248`), and the Studio header shows "Your places: Classes/Management/Configuration" above an Indonesian sub-nav (`studio/layout.tsx:68-77`).
- No language switch is mounted on `/`, `/konfigurasi`, `/studio/**`, `/evaluasi`, `/dekan/ringkasan`, `/edukator/ringkasan`, the refusal page, not-found or error (§3.1.3).

#### H. Other navigation observations
- **Dead ends.** `/dekan/ringkasan` and `/edukator/ringkasan` contain no link and no shell (0 `Link` in either file). They are reached from `/pimpinan` and `/konfigurasi`.
- **A tab that leads to a refusal.**
  - For SYSTEM_ADMIN, `/aktivasi` shows the pendataan-shell tab "Pendataan" / "Intake", which leads to `/pendataan` (refuses SA) (`CangkangPengalaman.tsx:180`; `pendataan/page.tsx:43-54`).
  - `/konfigurasi` hides the equivalent link for SA (:239).
  - The Studio sub-nav shows all nine items to every admitted role, whatever the per-page capability (§3.3.6).
- **No way back from `/belajar` for senior roles.** A HOD, DEAN or admin who opens `/belajar` gets the learner shell (Belajar, Sertifikat, Help), and the learner tour is mounted for them. No tab returns them to their place (`pembelajaran.ts:79-82`; `belajar/page.tsx:158`, `:362`).
- **Missing h1.** `/belajar/[tugas]/sertifikat` in the ELIGIBLE state and `/studio/kanonik/[terbitan]` have no heading. The Studio pages use h2 under the layout's single h1 "Studio".
- **Field labels borrowed from Konfigurasi sections.** Studio definisi and sertifikat label the school `<select>` with `config.section.roles` "Peran & akses" (`studio/definisi/page.tsx:59`; `studio/sertifikat/page.tsx:39`). The Konfigurasi flags form labels its school select `config.section.system` "Sistem & Konfigurasi" (`konfigurasi/page.tsx:582`). Both JSON forms on `/studio/unggah` use the button "Buat Paket Pembelajaran" (:96, :115).
- **Unused and phantom entries.** `nav.akun` "Akun" / "Account" is defined (`hle.ts:1783`) and used nowhere in `src/`. `/masuk/kartu` is in `PUBLIC_PATHS` (`proxy.ts:16`) with no page.
- **Scope wording differs between educator and Pimpinan surfaces.** The educator tour says "lingkup mengajar" / "teaching **context**" and the page says "teaching **scope**". Pimpinan uses "Bagian sekolah" / "Part of the school" and "Bagian sekolah yang Anda pimpin" / "The part of the school you lead".

## Limits of this inventory

- **Static reading.** Every string was traced from the code, not observed on a running screen, except where §1.2 says a file was produced by running its builder. Names of schools, classes, courses, lessons and people are data, not terminology. They appear only in §1.2 (seed data) and as "(data: …)" in Table 3.
- **Routes and roles are upper bounds for shared components.** A string in a shared shell or card is listed against every route whose import graph reaches it. The shell may still show it only to some roles; the role-by-role picture is in Table 3.
- **Type** comes from the markup around the call. When the call is inside a helper or a lookup table, it comes from the key's name and is marked `*`.
- **"English never shown"** is decided per call site. Calls whose language could not be determined statically (keys held in lookup tables and rendered elsewhere) are not flagged, so the 199 flagged rows are a lower bound.
- **Families are lexical.** They include words used in another sense ("bagian" as "part", "isi" as "fill in", "kunci" as "key"). Those ambiguities are part of the evidence.
- **Not in the repository.** The sign-in e-mail is Supabase's default template or whatever the hosted project's dashboard holds; no template is committed (§1.2.5).
- **Scope in time.** Taken at `15bfc99`. DAISY-13 (held until BOB-12) and BOB-20 (Integration 14) will change some wording; neither is included.
- **Reproducing it.** Table 1 and Table 2 were generated from `src/lib/hle.ts` and a sweep of `src/` by throwaway scripts that were not committed, so this change stays documentation only. The method above is enough to repeat the sweep, and the scripts can be provided if wanted.
